zh: 把每个字符看成权值：普通字符记 1，特殊字符记 0，问题就变成“和不超过 k 的最长连续子数组”，而且所有权值都非负。
权值非负意味着缩短窗口不会让普通字符数变多，所以对每个右端点，合法的左端点是一段连续区间，可以用滑动窗口：右端点右移时左端点只会向右走。
右端点从左到右扫描，遇到 charValue 对应为 0 的字符就让计数加一；计数超过 k 时不断右移左端点，并在移出普通字符时减一；每步用 right−left+1 更新最大长度并输出。
en: Give each character a weight: 1 for a normal character and 0 for a special one. The task becomes the longest contiguous subarray with sum at most k, and all weights are non-negative.

Non-negative weights mean that shrinking a window never increases the count of normal characters, so for each right end the valid left ends form a contiguous range, and a sliding window works: the left end only moves right as the right end moves right.

Move the right end from left to right, increasing the count whenever the character's charValue is 0. While the count exceeds k, advance the left end, decreasing the count when a normal character leaves. Update the maximum with right-left+1 at each step and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Advance the right end while counting normal characters; when the count exceeds k, move the left end until the window is valid again.

## Proof of correctness

Normal characters contribute non-negative amounts, so shortening the window never increases the total. The smallest valid left end for each right end gives the longest valid substring for that right end; enumerating all right ends and taking the maximum gives the global optimum.

## Complexity

Time O(n), space O(1) apart from the input.
